recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for this issue unless Pharmacy later chooses to revise the example terminology independently of the datatype change.
issue_request: FHIR-52891 was an Applied Pharmacy R6 change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, to change MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenserInstruction from Annotation to CodeableConcept so dispenser instructions can be coded while still allowing text through CodeableConcept.text.
initial_application: The change was already applied through HL7/fhir#3896: f37f918759 changed the element datatype to CodeableConcept, 90c6b7a8 added the example binding and initial terminology, and bdbe9a3a0e/e827825305 cleaned up the terminology source. Those commits are ancestors of the combined branch.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists medicationrequest as an active resource and tracks MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenserInstruction in R6 element metadata. Pharmacy Confluence records support the Jira decision: September 2025 WGM minutes discuss changing the element to CodeableConcept while preserving free text, and the 2025-10-06 Pharmacy notes record FHIR-52891 as persuasive with modification. No conflicting Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml definition for MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.dispenserInstruction already has type CodeableConcept and an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationrequest-dispenser-instructions.
